name: catalog
description: Read the React authoring contract, components and starter source.

name: upload
description: Upload a Crew attachment to the caller's existing upload area.

name: list
description: Find accessible dashboards and their saved document paths.

name: get
description: Read a dashboard bundle and its current revision.

name: link
description: Get an authenticated live link; the link grants no new access.

name: create
description: Create a React dashboard draft from its title and files.

name: update
description: Edit draft files using the current expected_revision.

name: validate
description: Check a saved revision or HTML document, SQL and referenced files.

name: preview
description: Render a saved dashboard and return errors and screenshots.

name: export_static
description: Export a published dashboard and its authorized data as static files.

name: export_motion
description: Start or inspect a published dashboard's video export.

name: publish
description: Publish the expected draft revision to its live URL.

name: restore
description: Restore an earlier revision using the current expected_revision.

name: get
description: Inspect the product's current audience and selected shared agents.

name: set
description: Apply the owner's chosen audience, preserving people they did not ask to remove.
